headline: Suresh Patel files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Jash Engineering
sum: Suresh Patel has triggered SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure obligations by acquiring a substantial interest in Jash Engineering Limited. The filing signals a material stake acquisition or takeover intent in the industrial engineering company, subject to open-market and regulatory conditions.
detail: Suresh Patel has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure indicates acquisition of shares or voting rights triggering the 25% threshold or crossing a higher slab. The filing is a mandatory pre-offer stage in the statutory takeover regime and initiates the 4/6-week open-offer window unless exempted. Jash Engineering Limited, listed on NSE, is an industrial equipment and engineering services provider.
